moments.text: Infrared view looking out over the sea, wind turbines along the bottom edge; a tiny bright dot sits just upper right of the crosshair.
Open water only, no turbines; the dot wanders around the crosshair, drifting up near the N marker, then to the lower right.
Wind turbines slide in from the right and fill the frame as the view crosses a wind farm; the dot stays near the crosshair.
The turbines thin out and leave at the upper left; mostly open water remains, with the dot just below-left of the crosshair.
More turbines enter from the lower right and spread across the frame; the dot keeps wandering close to the crosshair to the end.
